messages:
maria: CI turned red on my PR (5123) — integration tests failing with auth-service: 500 when reading secrets. Looks like a KMS/access error in the log. Can someone help retrigger a targeted run without forcing a full image rebuild?

 tj: ugh, flaky secrets rotation again? quick check: can you paste the short failing log line?

 maria: here's the snippet: 
```
Error: failed to fetch secret 'service/auth/credentials': access denied (kms:Decrypt)
at auth/init.go:72
```

 tj: that screams either stale deploy token or CI runner lost KMS role. If it's environmental, a targeted rerun that preserves volumes/credentials might fail until we refresh secrets. But we can try a retrigger that skips image build to save time.

 jules: I can kick one off. Use the rerun helper: 
```
/ci rerun --scope=integration --skip-image-build --preserve-volumes
```
That will only reschedule the integration job matrix and keep the previously built artifacts.

 ci-bot: Received request from jules to rerun jobs: integration. Starting rerun (preserve-volumes=true, skip-image-build=true). Job ids: #4789, #4790.

 tj: also run a secrets health check while it's running: `ci secrets check pr/5123` — will surface any missing IAM/KMS bindings. If that returns a failure, we'll need to refresh the secret binding instead of just rerunning.

 jules: running check now...

 oncall-bot: secrets check for pr/5123: failed -> KMS role not attached to runner service account. Details: https://internal.ci/secret-checks/5123

 maria: ok that explains it. Is there a lightweight fix we can do now? attaching role requires infra approval.

 tj: short-term: you can re-run with the injected fallback creds so tests can proceed, but that changes test fidelity. Command: 
```
/ci rerun --scope=integration --skip-image-build --inject-fallback-creds
```
Use only for non-blocking merges. Otherwise infra-attention required.

 jules: the preserved rerun finished: two jobs passed, one still failing with the same KMS error (the one that runs against encrypted secrets). I stalled the inject fallback run; want to avoid masking the real issue.

 maria: thanks. I'll open an infra ticket to attach the role and then re-run the failing job once that's done. Can someone paste the minimal command I'll need to re-run that single failing shard?

 tj: once infra confirms, run: 
```
/ci rerun --job=integration:encrypted-keys --skip-image-build
```
That targets the failing shard only.

 jules: noted. I'll ping infra on the ticket and drop a quick checklist (role, deploy, smoke).

 maria: perfect — appreciate it. Closing the loop here once infra confirms. :thumbsup:

 oncall-bot: Reminder: if you need to rebuild images later use `--rebuild-images` flag, and if you only want artifacts preserved use `--preserve-volumes`. See /ci help for full options.

 maria: thanks everyone!
